LanguageData.LP_SecondLife.degreeDatas.colorE08A3Acol:
A past life went further. Walking the road again in this life, progress comes fast, with occasional memories of the past life.

- Past life level 8-14 (decided the first time this trait is gained)
- While adventurer level is below the past life level, all adventurer XP ×2; the bonus ends upon reaching the past life level
- Each level-up within the past life level has a 25% chance to recall the past life: current research project progress +30%, or +1 passion in a skill
- No effect when the adventurer system is off
LanguageData.LP_SystemHost.degreeDatas.colorE08A3Acol:
A voice in the head keeps issuing quests.

- Every 7 days 3 quests are issued (kill, craft, heal, harvest, research, capture; amounts rise with adventurer level); accept 1, with a 7-day deadline
- Upon completion claim one reward, choosing one of three: +1 adventurer ability point, fate talisman ×1, random item ×1
- Running out of time brings a 3-day system penalty (global work speed ×0.85); giving up voluntarily has no penalty
- Click the "system panel" button below the pawn to see quests and rewards
